title: Personal Protective Equipment — Part 2: Safety Footwear
titleHi: व्यक्तिगत सुरक्षा उपकरण — भाग 2: सुरक्षा जूते
qcoOrder: Footwear made from Leather and other materials (Quality Control) Order, 2020
scope: Specifies basic and additional requirements for safety footwear used for commercial and industrial workplaces, equipped with safety toecaps.
scopeHi: यह औद्योगिक कार्यस्थलों में उपयोग किए जाने वाले सुरक्षा जूतों में स्टील टो-कैप, सोल फिसलन और पंचर प्रतिरोध के मानकों को तय करता है।

keyTests.name: Penetration Resistance of Sole
keyTests.parameterLimit: Spike must not penetrate insole barrier

markingRequirements: IS 15298 (Part 2), ISI mark, CM/L number, Shoe size, Category (S1, S2, S3, S1P).
consumerTips: S1P or S3 safety shoes include both 200J steel toe cap and steel anti-nail penetration midsole.
industryGuidelines: Steel toecaps must comply with corrosion resistance testing.

clauses.title: Impact Resistance
clauses.content: Footwear tested at impact energy of 200 J shall retain clearance beneath toecap ≥ 14 mm.
clauses.contentHi: 200 जूल प्रभाव ऊर्जा पर परीक्षण में टो-कैप के नीचे निकासी 14 मिमी से कम नहीं होनी चाहिए।

demoNotice: SAMPLE/DEMO DATA — Modeled closely after official Bureau of Indian Standards specifications for demonstration purposes.
